en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Idrees, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Ayoub Bin Nuh, from Al Washha, from the one who mentioned it,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having disliked the residue (of the water) of everything whose flesh one cannot eat’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ahmad ibn Idris has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Ayyub ibn Nuh from al-Washsha’ from those whom he has mentioned who have said the following: “Abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
disliked using the leftover of the water from which inedible animals have drunk.”
